name: dense category tile grid behind a headline
looks: A bold two-line claim sits over a dense grid of dozens of small coloured tiles, each labelled with a different short content idea or format, built up in a loose stagger until the grid is packed and slightly overwhelming.
build: The category-tile-grid mechanic: a CSS/DOM grid of small cards, each with a random accent fill and a short label, scaling and fading in on a seeded per-card delay, while the headline stays layered above at full contrast.
sound: A fast, granular patter of soft ticks as the tiles land.
prompt: Behind a short, confident headline, fill the frame with a dense, loosely staggered grid of small coloured tiles, each labelled with a different idea or category, deliberately too many to read one by one, so the shot says there is a lot of noise to sort through before the product does the sorting.
